verdict.rationale: No documentation in the evidence pack describes per-second or usage-based billing for sandbox compute; instead, community reports describe Cloudflare Containers/Sandbox pricing as based on continuous vCPU/RAM allocation (e.g. '$51.84 per vCPU', '$58/month for just 1vCpu and 1GiB RAM when used continuously') and note the lack of an auto-idle-destroy mechanism, meaning costs can accrue beyond actual compute use rather than being billed strictly per-second of actual usage.
